title: *The Critical Release of the PPI & Retail Sales Report* FED RATES
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: September PPI (1.3% m/m vs 0.6%) was really bad, ~80% fuel-driven, and should push yields up, yet bonds are rallying.
Massive AI capex capital raises (SpaceX, Broadcom, Oracle ~$140B) are pulling money from tech into risk-free ~5% Treasuries, so yields fall despite hot inflation.
Empire, Philly Fed and AI underwriters (Anthropic revenue +46%) say the economy and AI trade are not rolling over yet; labor market is the canary, maybe a year out.
Retail sales control group missed (0.1 vs 0.3) with a downward revision, showing early consumer pressure outside gasoline.
The more stocks fall, the more likely Trump signs an Iran deal, which he expects to rocket both stocks and bonds.

calls.reason: Called 5.27% as the top in the 10y yield three weeks ago; AI-trade fear is driving buyers into risk-free 5% Treasuries and TLT is forming a bottom near its long-term floor (78.77).
calls.quote: 5.27 was going to be the top in the 10-year Treasury yield... I think this is the top.

calls.condition: If QQQ loses 715 it goes to 700
calls.reason: Capital-raise 'suckening' weighs on tech near term and he doesn't expect relief until the 20th-27th, but still sees QQQ at 800 by year-end with a big hardware rally back.
calls.quote: We just lost 725. Are we going to lose 715? It means we go down to 700.

calls.reason: Apple is the flight-to-safety tech stock during capital-raise selloffs because it doesn't raise capital; 'AAPL up, TLT up' is their signal.
calls.quote: tech stocks do poorly with the exception of Apple because Apple doesn't raise capital.

calls.reason: Reiterates his earlier call that AMD was overbought and to sell end-of-year calls; it is now down 13-14% from that call.
calls.quote: I said sell end of the year calls on AMD. And look at it now.

calls.reason: Most of the prior day's 15% drop happened during regular hours, so premarket strength doesn't mean the selling is over.
calls.quote: I think pre-market it is a little premature to argue that... oh the selling pain is over. I don't quite see that

notes: Date not stated in transcript; listing date used, but PPI/retail sales release day is likely Thu 2026-10-15 (prior-day chip selloff matches Hanke's Wed Oct 14). AMD call is a retrospective reiteration of an older sell-calls idea. TLT floor 78.77 folded into the TNX call. 765 was his earlier QQQ goal (peaked 762).
